title: Understanding Minimum Support Price (MSP)
description: MSP is the government-set price at which procurement is done

details.content: Government announces MSP before sowing season to help farmers plan
Farmers sell at MSP through official mandis, FCI, or government agencies
Wheat, Rice, Cotton, Sugarcane, Oil seeds, Pulses, Corn
MSP increases yearly based on inflation and cost of cultivation

tips: Check latest MSP rates on eNAM or agricultural ministry website before selling

title: Agricultural Mandi (Market) Tips
description: Strategies to get better prices in agricultural markets

tips.content: Avoid selling during peak harvest season. Wait for prices to stabilize.
Better quality produce fetches higher prices. Grade and sort before selling.
Check daily prices in multiple mandis. Use Agrimarket or eNAM platforms.
Sell directly to consumers, retailers, or processors to avoid middlemen.
Store produce properly to reduce losses and sell at better prices later.
Join FPO to get better bargaining power and market access.

title: Organic Farming Premium
description: Opportunities for organic produce in premium markets

benefits.value: 20-40% higher prices compared to conventional produce
Growing urban demand for organic, pesticide-free produce
International markets pay higher prices for certified organic
Organic farming maintains soil health and reduces input costs

certification: NPOP/IFOAM certification needed for premium prices
tips: Join organic producer groups for better market linkage

title: E-Commerce Platforms for Farmers
description: Digital platforms connecting farmers directly to buyers

platforms.description: National Agricultural Market - electronic trading of agricultural commodities
platforms.benefit: Transparent pricing, wider market access, reduced commission

platforms.name: AGRITECH
platforms.description: Platform connecting farmers with buyers and processors
platforms.benefit: Direct buyer access, no middlemen, fair prices

platforms.name: BigHaat

platforms.name: Local Retail Chains
